ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels covering approximately 92-95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters providing localized high contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) white blobs distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes; dense, high-frequency textured clusters located at the distal tips and along the lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 15% of the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by stochastic peaks and valleys; extreme pixel-amplitude variations at distal tips due to external biological protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the lateral margins toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters (diameters ranging 5-15 pixels) scattered across the ventral surface, with highest density on the lower medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe (medial position) and three fine horizontal linear marks on the lower left lobe near the fluke baseline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization (calcified clusters) along the distal edges and tips, causing significant distortion of the natural geometric contour.
